The Lawson welcomes you home from its front porch into an open main floor where the kitchen, dining, and great room flow seamlessly together.  The kitchen features full-height cabinetry, quartz counters, gas stove and a stainless-steel chimney hood fan. The large walk-in pantry and mudroom will keep your family organized. While a main floor bedroom provides dedicated private space for family or guests. Upstairs, 4 bedrooms are arranged to offer privacy and flexibility for larger households. A centrally located laundry room enhances everyday convenience with a washer and dryer included. The primary bedroom features a spacious walk-in/walk-through closet to the private ensuite, completing this thoughtfully designed family home. Front landscaping and 8 solar panels included. Look out your windows every day for tranquil pond views. Ready in November! *Renderings are representative - exterior colours may vary. (id:67522)
